---
title: "CS211 Quiz 1 Answers"
format:
  html:
    embed-resources: true
---

**1.** Where does the work in a GitHub codespace happen?

A) Only on your own computer
B) On the lab computer
C) On your collaborator's computer
D) On GitHub's computer

**Answer: D**

**2.** Which of these AI models was released as open source so anyone can download and run it?

A) DeepSeek
B) ChatGPT
C) Claude
D) Gemini

**Answer: A**

**3.** In GitHub, what is a codespace?

A) A development computer that GitHub runs for you, opened in the browser
B) A private repository
C) A kind of branch
D) A file that holds a website

**Answer: A**

**4.** In GitHub, a codespace is created from what?

A) Your whole GitHub account
B) A collaborator
C) One branch of the repository
D) A GitHub Pages site

**Answer: C**

**5.** In AI, what is an LLM (large language model)?

A) A program that only stores files
B) A shell used to run commands
C) A website for hosting repositories
D) An AI model you send a prompt to, and it gives you a response

**Answer: D**

**6.** What is GitHub?

A) A programming language used to build websites
B) A website for hosting files and tracking versions over time
C) A text editor that only works without internet
D) A web browser for viewing repositories

**Answer: B**

**7.** GitHub is built on which version-tracking tool?

A) Bash
B) Pages
C) Markdown
D) Git

**Answer: D**

**8.** When designing apps for vibe coding, which of these is a full featured design tool?

A) Figma
B) Bolt.New
C) AI Studio
D) Lovable

**Answer: A**

**9.** In GitHub, after you send a collaborator an invitation, what must happen before they can work on the repository?

A) They accept the invitation
B) You merge a branch
C) They create a codespace
D) You delete the README

**Answer: A**

**10.** In GitHub, what is a collaborator?

A) A backup copy of the repository
B) A file inside the repository
C) The name of a branch
D) Another GitHub user invited to work on the repository

**Answer: D**

**11.** What does GitHub Pages let you avoid?

A) Needing a traditional server to host the website
B) Writing HTML
C) Using a repository
D) Committing changes

**Answer: A**

**12.** When building an app with AI, what is the design plus vibe coding process?

A) Design the pages with AI assistance, generate a prototype, then give it to an LLM that assembles the final app
B) Publish the app, design the pages, then write the prototype
C) Assemble the app, write a spec, then design the pages
D) Generate a prototype, publish it, then design the pages

**Answer: A**

**13.** Why did DeepSeek cause Wall Street to panic in Spring 25?

A) It deleted financial data
B) It stopped all AI models from working
C) It challenged the idea that only companies with proprietary models would dominate AI
D) It cost more than every other model

**Answer: C**

**14.** Which company makes the LLM ChatGPT?

A) Anthropic
B) Google
C) DeepSeek
D) OpenAI

**Answer: D**

**15.** Which of these is an LLM (large language model)?

A) Git
B) DeepSeek
C) Bash
D) Codespaces

**Answer: B**

**16.** Which of these is an example of a tool (an external program) that an LLM (large language model) can call?

A) A branch
B) A commit message
C) A calculator
D) A README

**Answer: C**

**17.** In GitHub, you select a new branch, create a file, and commit it. Where is the file?

A) On `main` only
B) On both `main` and the new branch right away
C) On the new branch, but not yet on `main`
D) Nowhere until you delete the branch

**Answer: C**

**18.** Where do you set up GitHub Pages for a repository?

A) The Actions tab
B) The green Code button
C) Settings, then Pages
D) The gear icon next to About

**Answer: C**

**19.** According to the lecture, what are large language models (LLMs) especially good at?

A) Replacing GitHub
B) Writing software
C) Hosting websites
D) Repairing computers

**Answer: B**

**20.** What makes an LLM (large language model) multimodal?

A) Its prompts and responses can include text, images, audio, and video
B) It can only respond with text
C) It runs on several branches at once
D) It is open source

**Answer: A**

**21.** How do you create a new branch on GitHub?

A) Open the branch menu, type a new branch name, and select Create branch
B) Click Commits and choose New
C) Open Settings, then Branches, then Delete
D) Click the pencil icon on `README.md`

**Answer: A**

**22.** In GitHub, after merging a branch into `main`, how can you verify that the merge worked?

A) Delete the `main` branch
B) Open the Actions tab
C) Return to the `main` branch and check that the new file is there
D) Create a codespace from the merged branch

**Answer: C**
